# inngest_environment (Data Source)

Looks up one Inngest environment by ID or by name. Works for the production environment, custom environments and branch environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "inngest_environment" "production" {
  name = "production"
}

output "production_environment_id" {
  value = data.inngest_environment.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Environment ID. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Environment name, such as `production`, `staging` or a branch name. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`. The lookup fails when several environments have this name.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the environment is archived.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `type` (String) Environment type: `PRODUCTION`, `TEST` or `BRANCH`.
